summary: Audited simulation.py (586 lines) against PROJECT_CONTEXT.md §2 and SIMULATION_2D_PHYSICS/GUIDE/DEMOS docs. NO logic defect found and NO code changed (no invented fixes). Verified: (1) 3D plane-crossing interpolates between bracketing samples (lines 168-175) with downward bracket prev.y>3.05>=state.y; horizontal rule h=hypot(xc,zc)<=SCORE_RADIUS=0.105; flag-based outcome mapping (swish if no rim/board, board-in if board else rim-in) correct for all orderings incl. board-then-rim-then-in. (2) collision loop uses resolve_contacts (bounded multi-pass, no penetration infinite-loop), bounce_count/max_bounces and 2D hits<max_board_bounces cap bounces; restitution 0.70<1 = energy-decreasing. (3) simulate_2d byte-identical to frozen basketball_shot_2d.simulate over 432 (h0,ang,spin,v,dist) combos (outcome/made/entry/plane_h/peak/board/hits/edge/xF/xB/xbc/flight + full T/X/Y); obeys 2D deck (margin 0.012, board offset 0.15, window [2.75,3.85], rim radius 0.2287, EN 0.70/ET 0.85, cap 4, two endpoint circles, omega_z=spin*sin(theta)); canonical mapping BANK-IN->board-in/RATTLE-IN->rim-in. Verification: python test_core.py 13/13 PASS, python test_collision.py 24/24 OK, python -m py_compile simulation.py clean; probes: dead-centre swish (h=0.000), rim-in (contacts=['rim']), board-in (contacts=['backboard']), board+rim+in -> board-in, upward-crossing not scored, dt=1e-3 vs 1e-4 stable (swish, final state agrees to 6th decimal), no array aliasing. CROSS-FILE finding (NOT fixed, out of my write scope): experiment.batch_simulate (lines 112-225) and experiment.batch_simulate_2d (463-474,486-662) inline the physics+collision instead of reusing simulation.simulate_shot / simulate_2d — a latent drifted duplicate (PLAN §1/§3b); they currently agree with the scalar path on representative single shots (4/4 3D + 4/4 2D matched), so the integrator owns the consolidation call.
